title: Keep Your Heart Close to God
traveler_why: Beau is the Traveler with the big, brave heart, and tonight the Lord asks Solomon for his whole heart: Beau chooses to pray when he is tired, because little choices every day keep a heart close to Heavenly Father.
traveler_about: Beau fits tonight because Beau has a big, brave heart, and Solomon’s story is about keeping a heart close to God every single day. In Beau’s world today: Beau is tired at bedtime and wants to skip his prayer, just this once. Then he remembers that little skips can add up. He kneels by his bed, says a short prayer, and puts both hands over his heart. Just like Solomon heard in the Lord’s warning, Beau learned that we keep our hearts close by choosing Heavenly Father every day.
